title: Majestic Palm | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
meta_description: Majestic Palm is a 4.00 bedroom, 4.50 bathroom vacation rental.

normalized_matching_profile.name: Majestic Palm
normalized_matching_profile.description: Majestic Palm is a stunning luxury home with 4 stories, including one of the largest rooftop private entertainment terraces featuring spectacular views. The location is perfect—you're right next door to 30Avenue, The Donut Hole, and Destin Ice Market for incredible shopping and dining experiences. You're also right across the road from your beach access and just a few minutes west of one of the area's largest regional beach accesses with restrooms and parking. Plus, the neighborhood now boasts a community pool available for your enjoyment.From the front of the home, you'll walk up to the 2nd-floor open concept space. You're immediately greeted with an incredible entertainment area framing a large TV and electric fireplace. Head further in and you'll be amazed by the kitchen. If you love to cook, then this is the home for you: top-of-the-line appliances, plenty of counter space, double ovens, and wonderful sightlines to both the dining area and entertaining area. Off both the front and back of this floor are beautiful balcony spaces. Finishing off this level is a convenient half bathroom plus an office area. We hope you don't need to work on your vacation, but this home offers the perfect setup for it!1 bedroom is located on the 1st Floor while the other 3 bedrooms are on the 3rd Floor. The 4th Floor? This spot is all about stunning 30A views. This observation deck is the showcase of this home, with some much additional space to enjoy what a beach vacation is all about - fresh air, Gulf views and relaxation.Sleeping Arrangements:1st Floor, Bedroom 1: Queen bed, TV. Private access to shared bathroom with shower.3rd Floor, Bedroom 1: King bed, TV. Private bathroom with dual sinks and large shower.3rd Floor, Bedroom 2: King bed, TV. Private bathroom with tub/shower combo.3rd Floor, Bedroom 4: Full-over-full bunk bed, TV. Private bathroom with tub/shower combo.The Inlet Beach neighborhood, Twin Palms, is perfectly located next door to Rosemary Beach and within a few minutes of all the other unique South Walton beach communities. With the opening of the underpass for foot traffic, which goes under highway 98 and allows pedestrians and bikes to safely cross from the north to the south side without dealing with cars, accessing Rosemary Beach is now even easier. This also provides a more convenient way to walk to the beach and nearby shops. You'll find no shortage of things to do with a stay at Majestic Palm.Beach Access:Head back out of the neighborhood towards Wall Street. From the north side, take Wall Street Across Hwy 98 where it will end at your Beach Access, Wall Street Public Beach Access.Distance: .4 miles | Time: 10 minutes walking, 3 minutes bikingInlet Beach:The location can't be beat! You're minutes from 30Avenue where you'll find no shortage of dining and shopping options. If you're looking to explore the area's natural beauty, Camp Helen State Park is practically right next door. Minutes from Rosemary Beach to the west and Panama City Beach to the east, you'll be pleased to have everything you could want on your 30A vacation at your fingertips.Your stay at Majestic Palm comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Sorry, no pets allowed.* Parking for 4 cars (2 in garage).An initial Benchmark signature box of amenities is provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, 1 pack of kitchen wipes and liners for each trashcan plus 2 washing machine pods. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of facial and bath soaps/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom.
